name: methods-bullets
text:
Corpus: 30 legal PDFs, 590 pages.
Questions: 100 total; 95 have gold page annotations.
Answer types: 32 boolean, 30 free text, 17 number, 15 name, 5 names, 1 date.
Paired comparison: raw pages → filter pass A → final answer-aware pages.
Metrics: macro precision, recall, and Fβ with β = 2.5.
Uncertainty: 20,000 paired bootstrap resamples over 95 questions.

name: findings-bullets
text:
Observed gain: final attribution removes excess pages and raises precision from 63.8% to 73.9%.
Small recall cost: 96.8% → 95.2%; no question loses every correct page.
Best fit: single-page and numeric questions benefit most.
Failure mode: multi-page and multi-document questions lose supporting evidence.

name: limitations
text:
One saved run; no repeated seeds. Overall Fβ: +1.5 pp (95% CI −0.3 to +3.1).
OCR was not exercised: all 590 pages exposed extractable text.
Multi-page evidence regresses; mean first-token latency is 6.39 s.

[Method]
Macro page precision, recall, and F-beta (beta=2.5) were recomputed from the 95 non-empty gold-page records. Confidence intervals use a paired non-parametric bootstrap over questions with 20,000 resamples and seed 20260903. The chart reports raw retrieval, pass-A filtering, and final answer-aware attribution for the same questions.
